findings.title: SQL injection in invoice filter
findings.description: User-supplied `sort` reaches the query builder unescaped in src/invoice/list.ts.
findings.evidence:
src/invoice/list.ts:41
  const order = req.query.sort;
  db.raw(`SELECT * FROM invoices ORDER BY ${order}`)
validated: payload `sort=id;--` altered the query plan

findings.title: Webhook secret compared with ==
findings.description: The webhook receiver compares the signature with a non-constant-time equality in src/webhooks/verify.ts.
